purpose: Resolve takeover censoring versus upstream failure on the already-used development seeds, not final held-out SR.
controls: Same task base checkpoint, prompt, norm, reset seeds and policy query RNG as the 40-raw gated pilot.
questions: Does the autonomous policy grasp/lift after the recorded baseline gate time?
How often does Goal-OOD impair grasp before the nominal placement stage, relative to paired ID?
boundary: Never interpret absent grasp in a gate-truncated prefix as proof that the autonomous policy cannot grasp.
